fields.value: EEG data of 239 participants during passive viewing of IAPS images in clearly distinct valence categories (positive, neutral, negative) with MatLab scripts
Includes analysis of long latency valence effects (1500-2500ms) and affective salience effects in the LPP (500-1300ms)

value: Affective Salience and Valence in (Very) Long-Latency ERPs to IAPS images

dsDescriptionValue.value: The dataset contains EEG data (raw and preprocessed) of 239 participants that passively viewed 150 IAPS images in three clearly distinct valence categories (positive, neutral, and negative) based on normative valence ratings. Participants provided subjective ratings for each image. MatLab analysis scripts are included.

publicationCitation.value: Revers, H., Stekelenburg, J.J., Vroomen, J., Van Deun, K. and Bastiaansen, M. (2025), Dissociating Affective Salience and Valence in (Very) Long-Latency ERPs. Psychophysiology, 62: e70030. https://doi.org/10.1111/psyp.70030

fields.value: EEG was collected from 239 participants who passively viewed 150 IAPS images in 3 distinct valence categories (positive, neutral, negative). In the aggregated ERP data, an affective salience effect (pos/neg > neu) can be observed in the LPP latency range (500-1300 ms) followed by a valence effect (neg > pos) in a late latency range (1500-2500ms). Raw and preprocessed EEG data are included, as are all MatLab scripts for the analyses.

value: Behavioural data (subjective valence and arousal ratings, and calculated affective salience ratings)
